{{Otheruses|Overseer}}
An '''overseer''' was the [[Pentastar Alignment]]'s equivalent to a [[Governor/Legends|governor]] and was appointed at the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] or [[Sector/Legends|sector]] level. Overseers were appointed by the [[Chamber of Order]], though individuals with the rank could not claim a position on the body.<ref name="Pentastar Alignment">''{{JournalCite|3|The Pentastar Alignment|reprint=1}}''</ref>
